main_text.p: sanctissimum subinouisset, & throno Constantinopolitanum occupasset, se in eo statu neque tutum, neq; extra periculum ullo unquam tempore reputans, nisi approbatorem firmatoremq; suæ dignitatis Pontificem Rom. haberet, cuius erat similia statuere, scripsit ad Nicolaum per id tempus Ecclesiæ Catholicæ moderatorem, demisso atque humili animo approbationem expofcens. Nicolaus in se causam assumens, Photij, & Ignatij iuribus examinatis, incorrupte sententiam protulit, Sedem Ignatio adiudicauit, amissam iniquissimis dolis dignitatem resti-tutam integre conservavit ipse, & Concilium Constantinopoli celebratum audiens, & obediens obfirmatis decretis Pontificijs, Pho-

page.notes: The text is set in one continuous paragraph across the page, with no indent visible. The last word is split at the line end ("Pho-" / "tium"), and "tium" is the catchword. Long s is printed as a form close to f ("fanctiffimum", "fcripfit", "expofcens"); I have read these as s. The word "conservavit" is printed "conseruauit"; the u values are changed to v as the rules require. The scan is faint at the right edge, but no letters are lost there.
